origin.description: Expands a numeric range by a multiple of its width plus a constant.
origin.example:
expand_range(c(1, 1), mul = 0, add = 0.6)
expand_range(c(1, 1), mul = 1, add = 0.6)
expand_range(c(1, 9), mul = 0, add = 2)
